description: The plot illustrates the training loss over time for two models, with the red line labeled “SepLLM” and a purple line representing a baseline, both plotted against training time in seconds on the x-axis (ranging from 0 to 250,000 s) and loss on the y-axis (ranging from 2.40 to 2.75). The x-axis is linearly scaled with major ticks every 50,000 seconds, while the y-axis is linear with major ticks every 0.05 units. The red “SepLLM” line, marked with circular markers and a solid line, starts at approximately 2.75 loss at 0 seconds and steadily decreases to about 2.49 by 250,000 seconds. The purple line, marked with triangular markers and a solid line, begins slightly lower at around 2.73 and declines more gradually, ending near 2.50 at 250,000 seconds. A green dashed horizontal line at loss = 2.50 and vertical dashed lines at approximately 200,000 and 250,000 seconds highlight a region where SepLLM achieves a 1.26× speedup relative to the baseline, as annotated in the plot. Both curves exhibit a smooth, monotonic decline, with SepLLM consistently achieving lower loss than the baseline across the entire training duration.
